_comment: Editorial content for NCML. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. Note the 2026 restructuring disclosed in the company's own annual report: the description reflects it rather than the long-standing 'cotton mills' name.
description: Nazir Cotton Mills Limited operated as a textile spinning unit until 2006, when it moved into the dairy business; its products page describes cattle, sheep and poultry rearing, breeding, and trade in milk, meat, eggs and livestock. In 2026 its shareholders approved a restructuring that shifts the company's primary focus to income-generating investments, renames the enterprise Nazir Ventures Limited, and authorises the sale of its land, with the proceeds to be deployed into revenue-earning investments.
headOffice: Tricon Corporate Centre, Office No. 702, 7th Floor, 73-E, Main Jail Road, Gulberg-II, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: nazircotton.com — Annual Report 2026 (Chairman's Review) and the Products and Company Profile pages (accessed 2026-10-17)
